patterns.note: Asymmetrical section layouts frequently pair large 3D renders or video game screenshots with text blocks, often with the visual element dominating one side of the screen.
The site uses an extremely oversized, wide, and bold display font for hero text and key headings, contrasted with smaller, functional sans-serif for body copy and monospaced text for labels.
A high-contrast palette of deep charcoal/black and vibrant neon green is used throughout, with white for primary text, creating an energetic and modern feel.

Sections reveal with a subtle fade-in and slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, while a repeating background pattern scrolls at a slower rate than foreground content, creating a parallax effect.
Full-bleed sections with dark backgrounds are used to segment content, often featuring a large, impactful visual (video, 3D render, app screenshot) as the focal point.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-bleed video background with overlaid text and calls to action. As the user scrolls, the video background scrolls with a subtle parallax, allowing content to scroll over it.

The primary navigation bar starts transparent over the hero video, then transforms into a sticky element with a solid dark background and slightly reduced height once the user scrolls past the initial hero view.
Content sections are revealed using scroll-triggered animations (css-keyframes), where elements fade in and slide upwards from the bottom as they become visible in the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, wide, and bold hero text (~5-6x body) with large, bold headings and smaller, functional body text, often accompanied by uppercase monospaced labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are dominant for content blocks and overall layout, with subtle rounding applied to interactive elements like buttons and input fields.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical padding between full-bleed sections and ample whitespace around key visual elements and text blocks.

standout: The aggressive and high-energy aesthetic is distinctive, driven by the bold, oversized typography, the pervasive use of a vibrant neon green accent, and the integration of high-fidelity 3D renders and video, creating a powerful, game-centric brand identity.
